_source: StoreHub Brand Guideline PDF (59 pages, March 2026)
tagline: More Than Just a POS System
tagline_alt: The All-In-One Platform for Your Restaurant or Retail Store

logo.description: STOREHUB wordmark — 'STORE' in StoreHub Orange (#ff9419), 'HUB' in StoreHub Black (#2f2922). Custom 'H' logomark acts as icon/app icon.
logo.icon_logomark: H mark (two vertical bars with diagonal — orange + black)
logo.clear_space: Apply proportional width of the H logomark on all sides
usage_rules: Always use primary wordmark when possible
H logomark alone only when StoreHub branding is already strongly established
Ensure high contrast between logo and background
NEVER stretch, rotate, or apply effects
NEVER use wordmark and logomark together in same layout
Dark background: use white wordmark version
Orange background: use white wordmark version

colors._note: Always prioritize brand colours (orange + black). Accent colours used to add variety.

forbidden: Do NOT mix orange with blue/green in gradients
Only blend harmonious colours as shown in approved list
Do NOT mix orange with green

typography._note: Barlow for all headlines. Open Sans for body. Display fonts (Caveat/Gochi Hand) used sparingly for lifestyle copy only.

english.display_use: Lifestyle copy only — NOT for headlines or body

headline.rule: Headlines must be 100% of base size, at least 30% larger than sub-headlines

sub_headline.rule: Sub-headlines introduce sections, smaller than headline, larger than body

body.rule: Clear and legible at standard reading sizes

don_ts: Never use same size for headline, sub-headline, and body
Never make sub-headline larger than headline
Never bold every text level — reserve bold for emphasis only
Headline must always be the largest element on the composition

ad_specific._source: B2B Ad Visual Guideline PDF (StoreHub internal)
ad_specific._note: These rules apply specifically to static ad creatives (1:1, 16:9, 9:16). They take precedence over the general hierarchy above for ad formats.

headline.capitalisation: Title Case / Sentence case / ALL CAPS (short copy only)
headline.rule: Must be the most visible element. Either all one colour or highlight main point in a bright accent.

sub_headline.font: Open Sans Semibold or Semibold Italic
sub_headline.rule: Always smaller than headline. Keep it simple and straightforward. Single colour for readability.

body_copy.format: Bullet list — max 1 line per bullet point
body_copy.busy_bg_rule: On busy photo backgrounds: wrap bullets in solid colour panel or 70-90% transparent colour background
body_copy.rule: Keep each bullet to similar length so they read cleanly and look visually balanced

cta.font: Open Sans Bold or Bold Italic
cta.colour: Orange #ff9419 or Pink #ff546f — always a bright warm colour
cta.rule: Short, easy to see, straight to the point. Max 1 line.

background_photo._source: B2B Ad Visual Guideline PDF (StoreHub internal)
background_photo.visual_complexity: Prefer backgrounds with fewer colours and less visual noise — text must be readable
busy_background_fixes: Apply a solid colour overlay on busy areas behind text
Apply a 70-90% opacity colour block behind text for readability
Search 'blur' in Canva elements tab for blur overlay objects
sources: Canva Photo Bank — accessible, limited choice
Freepik — good stock, strong Asian talent selection
Envato Elements — large library, fewer Asian faces
Canva AI Text-to-Image — powerful for scene backgrounds, imperfect for humans

video_subtitles.super_box: StoreHub Orange (#ff9419) at 100% opacity, white text

text_stylizations: Colored Drop Shadow — shadow color from Barlow palette
Box Highlight — orange rectangle, 4px rounded corners

required: Authentic and genuine — no staged stock looks
Subtly featuring StoreHub products in real context
contexts: Merchant cooking or working in kitchen

color_correction.brightness: Well-lit — not overly dark or washed out
color_correction.contrast: Sharp and dynamic — not flat or harsh
color_correction.saturation: Rich and vibrant — not dull or faded

line_icons.rule: Designated exclusively for functional and interactive elements (buttons, nav, form fields)

orange_palette.use_case: Primary default — Presentation Decks and Social Media
orange_palette.rule: Default choice for all social media graphics and presentations

blue_palette.use_case: Visual Presentations (VP) and secondary social media variety
blue_palette.rule: Secondary option for social media to provide visual variety

colored_mixed.rule: STRICTLY PROHIBITED for websites and social media

tone_of_voice.audience_connection: Speak to real business owners — acknowledge their daily grind, celebrate their wins

good: More Than Just a POS System
The All-In-One Platform for Your Restaurant or Retail Store
Manage all online & offline transactions in one system
You're paying how much in delivery fees?
example_headlines.style_notes: Mix bold functional claims with empathetic merchant-focused language. Questions work well.

social_media_vp.style: Problem-solution focused, short and snappy, upbeat energetic music

btc_behind_the_counter.structure: Hook → Intro → Origins → Struggles → Lowest Point → Ending
btc_behind_the_counter.music: Background/cinematic for BTC, upbeat pop for VP

video_specs.animation_style: Easy Ease for all movements — smooth, natural, purposeful. No distracting animations.
video_specs.logo_placement: Top-right corner across all formats. Always within safe zone.

asset_library._note: Local file paths to approved brand assets. Use these in Pencil.dev via image operations.

logos.usage: Use primary_orange on light BGs. Use reverse_white on dark or orange BGs. Never use both wordmark and H-mark in same frame.

hardware_photos.selection_guide: Always match hardware to market. Use D3 Pro for MY flagship, Falcon for comparison/choice ads. PH: use Falcon Mini or Dual. TH: use TH-specific angles.

d3_scene_illustrations.description: 213 illustrations of the D3 POS in various scene/context/angle combinations. Use for product-hero frames with illustrated style.

brand_scenes.description: 64 brand scenario illustrations — merchants, stores, features in action.

launched_ads_reference.note: Reference these when designing new variants. Winners should be studied and evolved, not replaced wholesale.

testimonial_ads.status: READY TO TEST — never launched at scale. All 3 formats (Square/Portrait/Landscape) available per merchant per quote angle.

quote_angles: Awesome — 'StoreHub POS is awesome, efficient, & up to date.'
Fast — 'With StoreHub POS, everything is very fast.'
Aperture.best_format: Portrait — food on table with POS in frame. Looks like food content, stops scroll.

quote_angles: Queues — 'We cut our queue times in half.'
Binq Dessert.strength: Multi-location signal in location pill = growth aspiration for audience

quote_angles: Stable — 'Absolutely reliable and stable. No complaints.'
Best-Seller — 'Helps us create our next new design to create a best seller. Reporting helps analyse shopping patterns.'
Matchy & Co.strength: Unique angle — StoreHub as a product/trend intelligence tool, not just POS

quote_angles: Intuitive — 'Very intuitive. I highly recommend for a seamless, easy-to-use system.'
Robb Augustin.format_note: Cream BG split layout with hardware + stars + checklist — no merchant face

Rony Ahmed.strength: Real merchant face in real store (grocery context = relatable for retail segment)

quote_angles: 2016 — 'Working with StoreHub since 2016. Great system. Two stores synced — we check stock across both.'
The Bike Artisans.strength: Longevity signal (since 2016) = strongest trust signal in the library. Multi-store sync angle.

templates.A_orange_bg: Orange BG → large quote → merchant name pill → location pill → photo in rounded card → 'BUILT FOR F&B/RETAIL'. Used by: Binq, Merchants Lane, Rony Ahmed.
templates.B_photo_bg: Full-bleed environment photo → orange speech bubble quote overlay → minimal branding. Looks organic. Used by: Aperture Portrait, Matchy & Co, Bike Artisans.
templates.C_cream_split: Cream BG → 5 stars + quote right → hardware left → orange checklist. Best for retargeting. Used by: Robb Augustin.

testimonial_ads.usage_guidance: Always pair with offer badge or CTA strip. Do NOT run standalone without 'Book a free demo' CTA. Test Template B (photo BG) for cold acquisition first — highest native content feel.
